title: DriftWatch: malware-detector lifetime under label delay, a fixed analyst budget and conformal drift monitoring
description:
Research software and a pre-registered study of how long a malware detector stays useful. One time-aware protocol (TESSERACT constraints C1-C3, reported with AUT and A-AUT) is applied to pre-extracted LAMDA (Android) and BODMAS (Windows PE) feature files to measure the effect of label delay, a fixed analyst budget, conformal sample selection and drift monitors.

The release contains code, configurations, aggregate result tables, figures, the claims ledger and the report chapters. It contains no dataset content apart from a small synthetic test fixture, and no malware samples.
notes: The datasets are not included and keep their own licences: LAMDA (MIT), BODMAS (code BSD-2-Clause; dataset used as published by its authors). Build them with `driftwatch data download` and `driftwatch data build`. AndroZoo and SOREL-20M are not used.
